parameters.name: DbName
parameters.description: The database name. The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_), and must be 1 to 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: EntityId
parameters.description: The entity ID, which uniquely identifies a user, such as a user ID or employee ID. Each entity can contain multiple face images. The ID can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_), and must be 1 to 64 characters in length.

sub_parameters.name: ExtraData
sub_parameters.description: The custom information. The value can contain letters, digits, punctuation marks, and Chinese characters. Maximum length: 512 characters.

sub_parameters.name: ImageURL
sub_parameters.description: The URL of the face image. The face must be a frontal, unoccluded, single-person face. We recommend that you use an OSS link in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS link outside the China (Shanghai) region, refer to [File URL processing](~~155645~~). Maximum URL length: 1024 characters.

parameters.name: QualityScoreThreshold
parameters.description: The quality score threshold. The new face image is analyzed for quality. If the quality score is less than this threshold, the face image does not meet quality requirements, and the addition fails. Valid values: \[0.0, 100.0]. A value of 0.0 or empty indicates that quality score check is not performed.

parameters.name: SimilarityScoreThresholdBetweenEntity
parameters.description:
The inter-entity similarity threshold. The new face image is compared with existing faces in all other **EntityId** entries. If the similarity score is greater than or equal to this threshold, a similar face exists in another **EntityId**, indicating a duplicate, and the addition fails. Valid values: \[0.0, 100.0]. A value of 0.0 or empty indicates that inter-entity similarity check is not performed. For reference values, see the **Thresholds** field in the response of the [CompareFace](~~151891~~) operation.

> The inter-entity similarity threshold check applies only to the first face image uploaded for each EntityId.

parameters.name: SimilarityScoreThresholdInEntity
parameters.description: The intra-entity similarity threshold. The new face image is compared with existing faces within the specified **EntityId**. If the similarity score is less than this threshold, the new face image is considered too different from existing faces, and the addition fails. If no faces exist within the **EntityId**, the addition succeeds. Valid values: \[0.0, 100.0]. A value of 0.0 or empty indicates that intra-entity similarity check is not performed. For reference values, see the **Thresholds** field in the response of the [CompareFace](~~151891~~) operation.
